title: Term explorer
description: How often terms are mentioned in a group or channels, relative to all comments and posts.

list.name: group
list.label: Group or channel
list.query: SELECT name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT group_name AS name, 0 AS position, group_name IN (SELECT platform FROM channels) AS platform FROM channel_groups UNION ALL SELECT channel, 1, false FROM channels WHERE analyzed) ORDER BY position, platform DESC, name
list.definition: SELECT name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT group_name AS name, 0 AS position, group_name IN (SELECT platform FROM channels) AS platform FROM channel_groups UNION ALL SELECT channel, 1, false FROM channels WHERE analyzed) ORDER BY position, platform DESC, name

panels.title: Share of comments and posts mentioning the term (per 1,000)
panels.description: Comments and posts that contain the term, per 1,000 comments and posts in the selected channels. Dividing by the total removes the daily and weekly activity swings, so the line shows the share of the conversation. Separate several terms with commas. Bucket: week sums whole ISO weeks (Monday to Sunday, UTC), as the long-term trends do; days and weeks reach back further than hours (180 days). Group rate: pooled divides all mentions by all comments and posts; macro averages each channel's share, so a big channel doesn't drown out the small ones (the long-term trends of groups use it).

targets.rawSql:
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT multiIf(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'week', toDateTime(toMonday(hour), 'UTC'), ${bucket:sqlstring} = 'day', toStartOfDay(hour), ${bucket:sqlstring} = 'hour', hour, $__timeInterval(hour)) AS time, channel, sum(docs) AS n
    FROM scope_hourly
    WHERE if(${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week'), hour >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime) AND hour < toStartOfDay($__toTime) + INTERVAL 1 DAY, $__timeFilter(hour)) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY time, channel
)
SELECT t.time AS time, t.term AS term,
       if(${rate:sqlstring} = 'macro', 1000 * t.share_sum / s.members, 1000 * t.docs / s.n)
           AS per_1000
FROM (
    SELECT time, term, sum(c.docs) AS docs, sum(c.docs / totals.n) AS share_sum
    FROM (
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'hour', hour, $__timeInterval(hour)) AS time, channel, term, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM term_hourly
    WHERE NOT ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND $__timeFilter(hour) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY time, channel, term
    UNION ALL
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'week', toDateTime(toMonday(day), 'UTC'), toDateTime(day, 'UTC')) AS time, channel, term, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM term_daily
    WHERE ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY time, channel, term
    ) AS c
    INNER JOIN totals USING (time, channel)
    GROUP BY time, term
) AS t
INNER JOIN (SELECT time, sum(n) AS n, count() AS members FROM totals GROUP BY time) AS s
    USING time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Mentions
panels.description: Comments and posts containing the term (each counts once).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, term, sum(docs) AS mentions
FROM (
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'hour', hour, $__timeInterval(hour)) AS time, channel, term, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM term_hourly
    WHERE NOT ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND $__timeFilter(hour) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY time, channel, term
    UNION ALL
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'week', toDateTime(toMonday(day), 'UTC'), toDateTime(day, 'UTC')) AS time, channel, term, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM term_daily
    WHERE ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY time, channel, term
)
GROUP BY time, term
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Distinct authors
panels.description: Different people mentioning the term. Few authors and many mentions usually means spam or one heated thread.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'hour', hour, $__timeInterval(hour)) AS time, term, uniqCombinedMerge(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM term_hourly
    WHERE NOT ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND $__timeFilter(hour) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY time, term
    UNION ALL
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'week', toDateTime(toMonday(day), 'UTC'), toDateTime(day, 'UTC')) AS time, term, uniqCombinedMerge(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM term_daily
    WHERE ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY time, term
)
ORDER BY time

SELECT t.term AS term, t.channel AS channel, t.docs AS mentions, t.authors AS authors,
       round(1000 * t.docs / s.docs, 2) AS per_1000
FROM (
    SELECT term, channel, sum(docs) AS docs, uniqCombinedMerge(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM (
    SELECT term, channel, sum(docs) AS docs, uniqCombinedMergeState(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM term_hourly
    WHERE NOT ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND $__timeFilter(hour) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY term, channel
    UNION ALL
    SELECT term, channel, sum(docs) AS docs, uniqCombinedMergeState(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM term_daily
    WHERE ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY term, channel
    )
    GROUP BY term, channel
) AS t
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT channel, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM scope_hourly
    WHERE if(${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week'), hour >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime) AND hour < toStartOfDay($__toTime) + INTERVAL 1 DAY, $__timeFilter(hour)) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
    GROUP BY channel
) AS s USING channel
ORDER BY mentions DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Recent mentions
panels.description: Raw text is only kept for 48 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT created_at AS time, channel, doc_type AS type, substring(text, 1, 400) AS text,
       url AS link
FROM items
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
  AND (arrayExists(t -> position(concat(' ', arrayStringConcat(splitByNonAlpha(lower(text)), ' '), ' '), concat(' ', arrayStringConcat(splitByNonAlpha(lower(t)), ' '), ' ')) > 0, splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) OR hasAny(intents, arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring}))))
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 100
